company.name: Sweep
company.shortDescription: Sweep is a software company developing software for businesses to reduce their carbon emissions.
company.description: Sweep is a software platform that helps companies understand, manage and reduce their carbon emissions across their entire business and value chain. The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Montpellier, France.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based sustainability data management platform for collecting, consolidating, validating, analyzing, and reporting ESG and carbon data across an organization and its value chain.
productsAndServices.name: Sweep Platform

productsAndServices.description: Software for measuring, calculating, and managing Scope 1, 2, and 3 greenhouse gas emissions, including corporate and product carbon footprints, with auditable data and emissions reduction tracking.
productsAndServices.name: Carbon Management

productsAndServices.description: A supplier engagement and data collection solution for obtaining primary Scope 3 emissions data, assessing supply-chain risks, and coordinating reduction activities across the value chain.
productsAndServices.name: Supplier Emissions

productsAndServices.description: ESG reporting software that reuses centralized sustainability data to prepare traceable, audit-ready disclosures across regulatory and voluntary reporting frameworks.
productsAndServices.name: Sustainability Reporting

productsAndServices.description: Software for setting emissions targets, modeling reduction pathways, planning initiatives, and tracking carbon and financial progress toward net-zero objectives.
productsAndServices.name: Decarbonization Strategy

productsAndServices.description: A solution for financial institutions to collect, map, analyze, and report carbon and sustainability data across investment portfolios, loans, and other financed activities.
productsAndServices.name: Financed Emissions Management
